# Scenario: config-repo clone auth failure writes git_login_failed and aborts
# the cycle; prior Docker/Nginx state is left unchanged.

cd git-repo
exec git init -b main
exec git config user.email 'test@apinfra.local'
exec git config user.name 'Test Agent'
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'feat: baseline reachable file repo'
cd ..

cp .apinfra.template .apinfra
exec sh -c 'echo "repo=file://'$WORK'/git-repo" >> .apinfra'

# --- Cycle 1: healthy deploy ---
exec apinfra
stderr 'done duration='
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-web-web
exists $HOME/infra/nginx/conf/dev_e2e-web.conf
! exists $HOME/.events

git-authfail-start

# Point at HTTP 401 stub with a token so go-git classifies the failure as auth.
cp .apinfra.authfail .apinfra

# --- Cycle 2: clone 401 → event + abort; stack untouched ---
exec apinfra
stderr 'git authentication failed'
stderr 'WARN cycle finished with errors'
stderr 'done duration='

exists $HOME/.events
grep 'git_login_failed' $HOME/.events
grep 'http://127.0.0.1:18081/repo' $HOME/.events

docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-web-web
exists $HOME/infra/nginx/conf/dev_e2e-web.conf

git-authfail-stop

-- .apinfra.template --
namespace=dev
repoBranch=main

-- .apinfra.authfail --
namespace=dev
repoBranch=main
repo=http://127.0.0.1:18081/repo
repoToken=bad-token

-- git-repo/dev/settings.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2e-web
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        port: 9999
      target:
        service-name: web
        port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: none

-- git-repo/dev/e2e-web/docker-compose.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: hashicorp/http-echo:latest
    command: ["-listen=:80", "-text=OK"]

-- .env --
